summary: bible/props.json authored with 24 plot-prop cards, each with scale.canonical_size / relative_anchor / prompt_token. 9 cards are readable-face props, whose main_01 is a two-view FRONT/BACK sheet. 48 images were generated (main_01 + scale_ref_01 per prop), all provider calls exit 0, and no person or body part appears in any image. The self-check found 4 major and 11 minor/info image defects; all images are kept as generated (retry budget 0) and listed in DEF-p4-prop-502 for the user to decide at H2. 10 props lack a dictionary term (DEF-p4-prop-501).
channel: image → volcengine model=doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628 (genmedia info); n=1 per call, no seed

user_refs.use: Look reference through style.json style_fragment_ui (verbatim in every prompt), and the hookah design (verdigris narghile, long hose). Not passed as --ref: the image contains a human figure, and the prop no-person rule allows only the prop's own images as refs.

prompt_assembly: English body + 'Overall visual style: ' + style_fragment_ui verbatim. --negative = negative_prompt_en verbatim + 'person, human, hand, arm, body, silhouette, face, fingers, people, figure'; PROP-sister-book (waking frame) also + negative_prompt_waking_addon_en. scale_ref_01 uses --ref main_01.png only.

plot_props_coverage_100.detail: 24/24 plot props carded; the coverage list matches the cards 1:1. structured_story has no entity tags, so props were extracted paragraph by paragraph from ch001-ch012 and cross-checked against the dictionary object terms and the ep01 screenplay. Items owned by other agents (set pieces, costume items, croquet animals) are listed in plot_prop_coverage.owned_elsewhere.

prop_scale_defined.detail: All 24 cards have the three scale fields filled; all 24 scale_ref_01.png files are on disk. Scale accuracy faults in 7 images are logged in DEF-p4-prop-502 (e, f, g, h, i, n; plus c and d duplications).

prop_image_no_person.detail: All 48 images checked by eye: no person, face, hand, body part or silhouette. generation_refs only ever point to the prop's own main_01.png; no concepts/characters or concepts/costumes paths. Info note DEF-p4-prop-502-o: the relief portrait on the anchor penny in 7 scale images.

prop_readable_face_defined.detail: 9 readable-face props, each with face_desc/back_desc/back_ref -> main_01.png as a FRONT/BACK two-view sheet, labels present in all 9. Lettering faults: DEF-p4-prop-502-a (letter) and -b (note-book).

no_unknown_placeholder.detail: No UNKNOWN/TBD/待定/未知 strings or empty strings in props.json.

name_hits_dictionary.detail: 14/24 names match a TERM. 10 names use source wording until they are registered (DEF-p4-prop-501, assigned to dictionary).

main_dir_hygiene.detail: Each <id>/ holds only main_01.png, scale_ref_01.png, prompts.json; no candidates were produced (n=1).

decisions: One card per dictionary term where the term bundles objects (gloves+fan, trumpet+scroll, crown+cushion); the tea-party teapot, rose-tree, glass table and the whole mushroom stay with 05-scenes as set pieces.
PROP-mushroom covers the hand-held pieces only and must match the SCN-caterpillar-clearing x9 mushroom build.
Hookah sized to the x9 caterpillar set (about 1.3 m on screen) and shaped after the user style reference.
Sizes are the prop's true size against its usual handler. Alice's size changes use duplicate builds of the same design (CR-005).
Readable faces other than the three whitelisted labels are specified as unreadable script (CR-012).
Soldiers' clubs, the thrown inkstand and kitchenware, and the guinea-pig bag are non-plot and never shown striking anyone (CR-010).
